messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 208

18. Maintenance and Repair Inspection 1. Unmount any tool/s or attachment/s or set the TCP/Payload/CoG according to tool specifications. 2. To move the robot arm in Freedrive: • On a 3PE Teach Pendant, rapidly light-press, release, light-press again and keep holding the 3PE button in this position. Power button 3PE button 3. Pull/Push the robot to a horizontally elongated position and release. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. 4. Verify the robot arm can maintain the position without support and without activating Freedrive. 18.3. Cleaning TP and CB Cleaning the Use a mild, industrial cleaning agent without thinning agents or any aggressive additives. Teach Do not use an abrasive material to wipe down the screen. Universal Robots does not Pendant promote a specific cleaning agent. Touch Screen Cleaning the Wipe down the Control box with a damp cloth, if necessary. Control Box Use the cleaning recommendation listed in the user manual. UR5e 211 User Manual
